description: Multi-chain whale & wallet portfolio profiler across Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum, and Polygon. Returns live USDC and native ETH/POL balances, total outgoing transaction counts (nonce), wallet tier (Whale/Trader/Retail), and smart contract vs EOA detection.

address.description: 0x... 40-hex EVM wallet or contract address to profile

payment_signature.description: Optional x402 v2/v1 Base64 or JSON EIP-3009 USDC payment signature to unlock the full unmasked dataset directly via MCP

x_api_key.description: Optional ak_live_... 30-day Prepaid API Pass key to unlock the full unmasked dataset

name: wallet_profiler
